body.purpose: Operational copy, values, and record detail.

label.purpose: Buttons, tabs, filters, columns, and compact status.

mono.purpose: Identifiers, hashes, code, timestamps, and technical state.

shadows.name: popover-lift
shadows.purpose: Context menus, popovers, and blocking overlays only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and compact state feedback.

motion.name: surface-standard

components.name: Utility Button
components.description: Compact neutral action for routine work.
components.css: .ds-utility-button { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 600 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-utility-button:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-utility-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-utility-button:active { background: var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Run Control
components.description: The single prominent domain-named AI automation action; never a generic CRUD or Ask AI button.
components.html: <button class="ds-run-control" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7V5Z"/></svg>Recherche starten</button>
components.css: .ds-run-control { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); font: 650 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-run-control svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-run-control:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-run-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-run-control:active { filter: brightness(.88); }

components.name: Compact Input
components.description: Dense field with explicit focus and error affordance.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--muted); font: 600 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, var(--line)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A compact filter or status, one of the few pill-shaped elements.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--text); font: 600 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-chip span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Connected Pane
components.description: Flat work surface separated by a crisp mechanical line.
components.css: .ds-pane { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pane header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-pane header strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-pane header span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-pane > div { padding: 10px; }

components.name: Window Lifecycle Header
components.description: Compact shell-owned identity, version/status, source/version actions, and native window controls.
components.css: .ds-window-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; height:32px; padding:0 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text); font:600 11px/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-window-header > strong { min-width:44px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-window-header > span,.ds-window-header > button { height:22px; padding:0 5px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); } @media (pointer:coarse) { .ds-window-header { height:44px; } .ds-window-header > button { min-width:36px; height:36px; } }

components.name: Responsive Resizable Workbench
components.description: Wide resizable panes that stack or use a visible shared drawer path when the app container narrows.
components.css: .ds-workbench { container-type:inline-size; display:grid; grid-template-columns:280px 8px minmax(0,1fr) 300px; min-height:0; } .ds-resizer { width:8px; border:0; border-inline:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; } @container (max-width:760px) { .ds-workbench { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows:auto minmax(360px,1fr) auto; overflow:auto; } .ds-resizer { display:none; } }

narrative.overview: CTOX Business OS feels like a precise Ableton-dense instrument built for repeated professional work. Routine controls remain visually quiet while each visible work surface may elevate at most one domain-named, typed-command AI automation through a clearly named Run Control. Floating windows resize to 640×480; at 600px and below the shell switches to a mobile sheet supported to 360px. The system rejects glossy SaaS dashboards, landing-page composition, generic AI surfaces, hidden compact panes, and app-specific reinventions of common controls.
keyCharacteristics: restrained color with one functional accent
mobile-sheet continuity with reachable shell controls
explicit selection, permission, sync, and run state

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: An app opens directly into its real workbench.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Accent communicates action, selection, or state and never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur, translucent glass cards, radial gradients, and ambient glow are prohibited by default.

rules.name: The Signature Automation Rule
rules.body: At most one real domain-named AI automation may consume prominent color or space per visible work surface.

rules.name: The Responsive Shell Rule
rules.body: Window, pane, header, Start, chat, and task switching remain operable from wide desktop through the 360px mobile floor.

dos: Do build routine UI from the existing canonical .ctox-* kit names.
Do use one-pixel separators, 3px control radii, 4px surface radii, and connected panes.
Do reserve the solid accent for focus, selection, and one signature Run Control.
Do prove real mouse window/pane resize and mobile-sheet interaction in the Business OS shell.
Do support keyboard operation, visible focus, Reduced Motion, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
donts: Don't create glossy dark SaaS dashboards with gradients, glow, glass cards, oversized radii, or heavy workspace shadows.
Don't use landing-page composition inside authenticated apps.
Don't build generic AI interfaces that hide records, scope, permissions, commands, or results.
Don't reinvent common controls inside an app.
Don't hide panes without a visible stack, tab, drawer, or back path.
Don't promote Create, Save, Export, Settings, or generic Ask AI into hero controls.
Don't hand-author a full-app loading skeleton.
